title: lvwf-television-championship-lvwf-1996
label: The Stud Muffin

won.source: LVWF's own first Era 3 broadcast (promotions/lvwf-1996/archive/lvwf-1996-friday-night-chaos-1996-08-19.html, msg_id rFBb2DIUTHEJ): a ten-way dance, won when The Stud Muffin pinned The Terminator with a top-rope clothesline he calls the decapitator.

how: Won a ten-way-dance elimination match to become the first champion.
note: No further defense or title change survives in the held record; the champion was due to defend against "Wing-Man" Tyler James the following Tuesday, a card not held here.
